content.text: Ask a helper to read the proof token, then finish your own turn.

toolsAdded.name: lookup_proof_token
toolsAdded.description: Read a proof token supplied by the host.

toolsAdded.name: spawn_agent
toolsAdded.description: Start a durable background subagent. Its ID remains available across turns and recovery.

toolsAdded.name: send_input
toolsAdded.description: Send a follow-up message to a durable subagent. Busy children queue the message.

toolsAdded.name: wait_agent
toolsAdded.description: Wait for the latest accepted Turn of each child and return its committed answer.

toolsAdded.name: close_agent
toolsAdded.description: Close a durable child and cancel all of its remaining work.
